_doc: Question bank written by scripts/merge_bank.py to work/<exam>/bank/question_bank.json and output/<exam>/question_bank.json

items.question: string
items.repair_confidence: high | medium | low (how complete the source wording was)
items.blind_agrees: boolean | null (independent re-solve agrees with the keyed answer)
source_pages: page numbers that carry this question
items.needs_review: boolean (true for every self-collected item: answers are not from an official key)
